term-get.label: kubectl get: Deployment, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap and Pods spread over the nodes

term-describe-svc.label: kubectl describe svc portal-624 and endpoints

term-describe-deploy.label: kubectl describe deployment admin-624 (events left out to fit the window)

term-rbac.label: RBAC: ServiceAccount, Role, RoleBinding, kubectl auth can-i
cmds: foreach ($t in 'get content-reader','patch content-reader','patch content-editor','delete content-editor') { $v,$s = $t -split ' '; '{0,-7} {1,-15} -> {2}' -f $v,$s,(kubectl auth can-i $v configmap/site-content -n iam624 --as=system:serviceaccount:iam624:$s) }

term-curl.label: curl tests with the host names mapped to the minikube IP

term-curl-security.label: HEAD request, security headers, HTML escaping, no POST on the public host

term-linux-hosts.label: Linux /etc/hosts on worker node exam624-m02, then plain curl by name (no --resolve)
cmds: minikube -p exam624 ssh -n exam624-m02 -- "grep -q iam-624 /etc/hosts || echo '192.168.253.133  www.iam-624.com  admin.iam-624.com  www.id-624.com' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts"
minikube -p exam624 ssh -n exam624-m02 -- "curl -s http://www.iam-624.com/ | grep -o 'pod portal-624[^<]*'"
minikube -p exam624 ssh -n exam624-m02 -- "curl -s http://www.id-624.com/research | grep -o 'pod app-research[^<]*'"
minikube -p exam624 ssh -n exam624-m02 -- "curl -s http://admin.iam-624.com/ | grep -o 'pod admin-624[^<]*'"

term-lb.label: Load balancing: replies per Pod and node (12 requests each)
cmds: 1..12 | % { curl.exe -s @h http://www.iam-624.com/ } | sls 'pod ([a-z0-9-]+) · node ([a-z0-9-]+)' | % { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value + '  @ ' + $_.Matches[0].Groups[2].Value } | group -NoElement | ft Count,Name -AutoSize

1..12 | % { curl.exe -s @h http://www.iam-624.com/research } | sls 'pod ([a-z0-9-]+) · node ([a-z0-9-]+)' | % { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value + '  @ ' + $_.Matches[0].Groups[2].Value } | group -NoElement | ft Count,Name -AutoSize

1..12 | % { curl.exe -s @h http://www.iam-624.com/api-624/x } | sls 'pod ([a-z0-9-]+) · node ([a-z0-9-]+)' | % { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value + '  @ ' + $_.Matches[0].Groups[2].Value } | group -NoElement | ft Count,Name -AutoSize

1..12 | % { curl.exe -s @h http://admin.iam-624.com/ } | sls 'pod ([a-z0-9-]+) · node ([a-z0-9-]+)' | % { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value + '  @ ' + $_.Matches[0].Groups[2].Value } | group -NoElement | ft Count,Name -AutoSize
